description: NPS Public Roads — the National Park Service road inventory (park roads incl. backcountry/unpaved). An inventory, not an OHV designation system: designation is 'unassessed' unless OPENTOPUBLIC is an explicit yes (36 CFR 4.10 makes OHV rules per-park; legality is never fabricated).

sources.name: NPS_Public_Roads FeatureServer layer 0 (Roads)
sources.method: esridump --jsonlines (FeatureServer supports pagination; no bulk download published)

stable_key: source_id (= GEOMETRYID GUID, falling back to FEATUREID then OBJECTID)
notes: Field names verified 2026-08-03 via ?f=json: RDNAME, MAPLABEL, RDSTATUS, RDCLASS (kept as road_class), RDSURFACE, SEASONAL ('Yes'/'No'/'Unknown' → seasonal Seasonal/Yearlong/omitted), SEASDESC (free text → shared season parser, failures → review queue; SEASON POLARITY TRAP: closure-phrased SEASDESC matching CLOSURE_HINT with no affirmative open/opens/opened wording NEVER emits a seasons attr — the parser emits OPEN windows and closure dates would invert legality — it lands in the review queue as seasdesc_closure instead), RDHICLEAR (kept as hiclear), RTENUMBER, RDMAINTAINER (manager), UNITCODE/UNITNAME (unit/unit_name), OPENTOPUBLIC (null on every live record today), GEOMETRYID/FEATUREID/OBJECTID. 'Unknown' values dropped from road_class/surface/hiclear. No miles field (Shape__Length is projected meters, not mapped). Client renders #B39DDB solid, MVUM-like widths.
